policy.change_control: Every production change must identify an owner, activation mode, rollback value, and affected services.
policy.secrets: Secret values belong in a 0600 environment or secret file and must never be committed or passed on a command line.
policy.pipeline_restart: checkpointed_restart means stop only at a documented checkpoint; never interrupt an active long-running batch to apply configuration.

assistant-scheduler.description: Assistant schedule leader and workspace job executor.

daily-ingest.description: Recurring discovery, extraction, and load pipeline.

embedding-service.description: Text embedding and vector retrieval endpoint.

frontend-release.description: Immutable Vue and financial-terminal browser assets.

ground-news-refresh.description: Ground News aggregation and image refresh loops.

postgres.description: Primary transactional and analytics PostgreSQL service.

web-api.description: FastAPI application and production static asset server.

variables.name: APP_ENV
variables.description: Runtime safety profile; production deployments must set production explicitly.

variables.name: APP_VERSION
variables.description: Semantic application version exposed by health endpoints.

variables.name: BUILD_ID
variables.description: Immutable release identifier used for readiness and deployment verification.

variables.name: GIT_SHA
variables.description: Source revision included in release diagnostics.

variables.name: HOST
variables.description: Web bind address; loopback is mandatory behind the local tunnel.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: Web listener and tunnel origin port.

variables.name: WEB_WORKERS
variables.description: Uvicorn worker count; capacity changes must account for database pool multiplication.

variables.name: FRONTEND_DIST
variables.description: Absolute path to a verified immutable frontend release directory.

variables.name: RELEASE_DIR
variables.description: Absolute root of the verified immutable release used to resolve executable code.

variables.name: GLOBEMIND_FRONTEND_PUBLIC_ROOT
variables.description: Read-only public dataset root, forced to the current immutable frontend release.

variables.name: GLOBEMIND_GENERATED_ASSET_ROOT
variables.description: Writable generated-media root kept outside immutable release directories.

variables.name: GLOBEMIND_WORKSPACE_ROOT
variables.description: Release-external user workspace root; the research workflow uses an isolated service directory beneath it.

variables.name: EVIDENCE_SNAPSHOT_ROOT
variables.description: Release-external immutable article snapshot and downstream-impact ledger root.

variables.name: SEARCH_SNAPSHOT_ROOT
variables.description: Release-external per-user append-only query-contract and ordered-result-ID snapshot root.

variables.name: MODEL_ASSURANCE_ROOT
variables.description: Release-external append-only model evaluation, calibration, drift, and rollback-evidence ledger root.

variables.name: PRIVACY_RIGHTS_ROOT
variables.description: Release-external append-only intake ledger for account deletion requests and cancellations; it does not represent completed erasure.

variables.name: IDENTITY_ASSURANCE_ROOT
variables.description: Release-external encrypted MFA enrollment, tracked-session revocation, and tamper-evident security-event ledger root.

variables.name: SERVICE_LEVEL_ROOT
variables.description: Release-external append-only, privacy-minimal search/export/report observation ledger. Measurements do not become approved SLOs without separate approver evidence.

variables.name: ENTITY_GOVERNANCE_ROOT
variables.description: Release-external append-only temporal entity-governance and human-review ledger root.

variables.name: FINANCIAL_ALERT_TRIAGE_ROOT
variables.description: Release-external append-only financial alert triage and postmortem ledger root; local hash chains are not WORM or an external trust anchor.

variables.name: HERMES_IMAGE_SCRIPT
variables.description: Image generation executable path, forced to the current immutable release.

variables.name: HERMES_IMAGE_ENV_FILE
variables.description: External owner-only configuration file for image-provider settings; never bundled in a release.

variables.name: GLOBEMIND_ENV_FILE
variables.description: Backward-compatible single explicit environment file; GLOBEMIND_ENV_FILES takes precedence.

variables.name: GLOBEMIND_ENV_FILES
variables.description: Path-separator-delimited, explicitly ordered environment files loaded before API imports; earlier files win.

variables.name: CORS_ORIGINS
variables.description: Comma-separated exact browser origins permitted by the API.

variables.name: ALLOW_RUNTIME_SCHEMA_MUTATIONS
variables.description: Emergency-only startup DDL switch; migrations remain the normal schema path.

variables.name: HTTP_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES
variables.description: Default maximum write request body size.

variables.name: HTTP_MAX_AI_REQUEST_BYTES
variables.description: Maximum request body forwarded to AI endpoints.

variables.name: HTTP_MAX_UPLOAD_REQUEST_BYTES
variables.description: Multipart upload ceiling including framing overhead.

variables.name: ENTITY_GOVERNANCE_HMAC_KEY
variables.description: HMAC key of at least 32 bytes for the local entity-governance chain; key identifiers and dual-key verification are not implemented, so rotation requires a separately controlled ledger migration.

variables.name: JWT_SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Signing key for access tokens and derivation key for identity-assurance event HMACs; rotation invalidates current sessions and makes existing local assurance chains unverifiable because JWT dual-key support is not implemented.

variables.name: USER_API_KEYS_ENCRYPTION_KEY
variables.description: Primary Fernet key for user-owned provider credentials and MFA TOTP enrollment secrets.

variables.name: USER_API_KEYS_DECRYPTION_KEYS
variables.description: Previous Fernet keys retained temporarily for decrypting user API-key and MFA ciphertext during rotation.

variables.name: ADMIN_USER
variables.description: Legacy bootstrap administrator identity; database roles are authoritative after bootstrap.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Development-only legacy administrator password; prohibited as a production login path.

variables.name: SEED_DEFAULT_USER_PASSWORD
variables.description: One-time bootstrap password; leave unset after initial provisioning.

variables.name: WORKSPACE_UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_BYTES
variables.description: Maximum size of one workspace upload.

variables.name: WORKSPACE_UPLOAD_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES
variables.description: Aggregate payload ceiling for a workspace upload request.

variables.name: WORKSPACE_USER_MAX_BYTES
variables.description: Total disk quota across all workspaces owned by one user.

variables.name: WORKSPACE_DISK_MIN_FREE_BYTES
variables.description: Low-water mark below which new workspace writes are rejected.

variables.name: DB_HOST
variables.description: Canonical PostgreSQL hostname; replaces legacy PG_HOST at service boundaries.

variables.name: DB_PORT
variables.description: Canonical PostgreSQL TCP port.

variables.name: DB_NAME

variables.name: DB_USER
variables.description: Canonical least-privilege PostgreSQL role.

variables.name: DB_PASSWORD
variables.description: Legacy bootstrap secret; Web and pipeline runtime roles must use GLOBEMIND_DB_PASSWORD_FILE.

variables.name: GLOBEMIND_DB_PASSWORD_FILE

variables.name: DB_SSLMODE
variables.description: Explicit libpq transport policy; implicit prefer/downgrade is forbidden.

variables.name: DAILY_INGEST_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE_FILE

variables.name: DAILY_INGEST_ALLOW_LEGACY_DB_ROLE
